definition: having a level surface with no slope
description: A bright marble barber's shop with lit mirrors and shelves of bottles. A gorilla sits in the barber's chair under a black cape, with an enormous round afro standing out around its head. A ginger cat in a white barber's coat and a red bow tie stands on the arm of the chair and runs a pair of electric clippers up the side of the afro, cutting a clean line into it. Clumps of black hair drop onto the cape. The cat works its way round, then swaps to scissors and trims across the top, and what is left is a squared-off block of hair with a perfectly level top, like a table top on the gorilla's head. The gorilla looks straight ahead, unimpressed, while the cat finishes and gives a small nod of approval.
